aiResearchSummary.text: Reelables is researching a wireless communication tape and flexible wireless labels as printable reeled media for tracking items across asset tracking applications. Method of fabrication of low power electronic tape for tracking items and wireless label assignment identification during printing focus on ultrathin, laminated, low power tapes linked to serialization systems. Thin film wireless label with integrated temperature sensor targets temperature monitoring. Together these efforts target tracking, identification, and condition monitoring.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
